title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求泽珞族的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Zroni to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Zroni

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求泽珞族的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Zroni to our own.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将泽珞族文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对灵能研究的洞见将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the Zroni artifacts into our research process. Their insights into psionic study will greatly aid our own research.
